edges.reason: msg.sender is the funding source pulled into the vault during depositCollateral.
msg.sender must equal borrower or an approved delegated manager before withdrawal.
msg.sender is treated as the lender whose interest is paid out.
Authorization is checked only when useCollateral is true.
msg.sender must be borrower or delegated manager to reduce duration.
Interest owed is computed from block.timestamp elapsed time.
Back interest and the new endTimestamp are derived from block.timestamp.
secondsReduced and endTimestamp adjustments depend on block.timestamp.
interestDepositRemaining is computed against block.timestamp.
nonReentrant modifier locks reentrancyLock around withdrawCollateral.
nonReentrant modifier locks reentrancyLock around depositCollateral.

nonReentrant modifier locks reentrancyLock around reduceLoanDuration.

Accrued interest is forwarded to the transfer helper.
Lender payout leaves the contract through an external ERC20 transfer.

Ether collateral withdrawal unwraps and sends value to the receiver.
Token collateral withdrawal performs an external token transfer.

Interest deposit can be sourced by swapping borrower collateral.

Deposit amount is an attribute of the depositCollateral call only.
Withdraw amount is an attribute of the withdrawCollateral call only.
Receiver is the destination of the value transfer in vaultEtherWithdraw.
Target is consumed directly by _setTarget to write the dispatch table.
Selector is consumed directly by _setTarget as the mapping key.
Value bounds array is forwarded into the delegatecall payload.
Storage pointer aliasing the loans mapping used by withdrawCollateral.
Storage pointer aliasing loanParams used by withdrawCollateral.
Resolved token address decides the vault transfer path.
Clamped amount is an intermediate of the withdrawCollateral computation.
Accrued interest is the amount passed into the payout helper.
Back interest is an intermediate value inside extendLoanDuration.
